description: The chart illustrates quality score results for three methods (IFD, TagNum, and DEITA) using two averaged metrics and their corresponding baseline reference lines. The horizontal axis contains the categories IFD, TagNum, and DEITA in that left-to-right order and is labeled “Quality Scores,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Scores” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 30 to 70 with tick marks at regular 5-point intervals. Each category shows a pair of adjacent bars: a light blue bar labeled “Avg\_obj” and a light salmon bar labeled “Avg\_sub,” with numeric values printed above each bar. For IFD, the Avg\_obj bar is about 63.98 and the Avg\_sub bar is about 41.90; for TagNum, Avg\_obj is about 66.06 and Avg\_sub is about 39.13; for DEITA, Avg\_obj is about 67.64 and Avg\_sub is about 42.99. Two dashed horizontal reference lines are also shown: a blue dashed line labeled “Base Avg\_sub” at about 64.71 and an orange dashed line labeled “Base Avg\_sub” at about 37.91, with the values annotated near the right side of the plot. The bars are grouped by method (two bars per method) rather than stacked, and there is no indication that the categories are sorted beyond the displayed order; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the value labels and the legend.
